description: Defines the 'Region' class for representing and manipulating rectangular regions in the Android UI framework, including methods for region operations, containment checks, and serialization.

classes.name: Region
classes.description: Represents a geometric region composed of rectangles, supporting operations like union, intersection, subtraction, translation, and serialization.

methods.name: createTJunctionFreeRegion
methods.description: Creates a region without T-junctions from an existing region.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the region is empty.

methods.name: isRect
methods.description: Checks if the region is a single rectangle.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounding rectangle of the region.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a point or coordinate is within the region.

methods.name: makeBoundsSelf
methods.description: Converts the region to its bounding rectangle.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the region.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the region to a specified rectangle or size.

methods.name: orSelf
methods.description: Performs union with another rectangle or region.

methods.name: xorSelf
methods.description: Performs exclusive OR with another rectangle or region.

methods.name: andSelf
methods.description: Performs intersection with another rectangle or region.

methods.name: subtractSelf
methods.description: Subtracts another rectangle or region.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Returns a new region as the union of this and another rectangle or region.

methods.name: mergeExclusive
methods.description: Returns a new region as the exclusive OR of this and another rectangle or region.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Returns a new region as the intersection of this and another rectangle or region.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Returns a new region as the subtraction of another rectangle or region.

methods.name: translateSelf
methods.description: Translates the region by dx and dy.

methods.name: scaleSelf
methods.description: Scales the region by sx and sy.

methods.name: operator |
methods.description: Union operator.

methods.name: operator ^
methods.description: Exclusive OR operator.

methods.name: operator &
methods.description: Intersection operator.

methods.name: operator -
methods.description: Subtraction operator.

methods.name: operator +
methods.description: Translate by a point.
